tooltip: Orientation Mode – Flips the preview horizontally, vertically, or in both directions.
content1: Controls the orientation of the camera preview. Horizontal flip mirrors the image left to right, while vertical flip turns it upside down.
content2:
1. Horizontal – Flips the preview left/right.
2. Vertical – Flips the preview up/down.
Both options may be enabled together.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the horizontal and vertical flip states from the camera.
setAPIDes: Applies the selected horizontal and vertical flip states.

tooltip: Raw Noise Reduction – Reduces noise in RAW signals from each sensor signal line.
content1: Enables or disables the sensor's RAW noise-reduction processing.
content2:
1. RNR_DISABLE – Disables RAW noise reduction.
2. RNR_ENABLE – Enables RAW noise reduction.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current RAW noise-reduction state.
setAPIDes: Enables or disables RAW noise reduction.

tooltip: Trigger Mode – Selects master, readout-trigger, or shutter-trigger operation.
content1: Configures how sensor acquisition is initiated. Master mode disables external triggering. Readout and shutter modes start their respective sensor operations from an input trigger.
content2:
1. Master – Trigger mode is disabled.
2. Readout – An input trigger starts sensor readout.
3. Shutter – An input trigger starts the shutter operation.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the currently selected trigger mode.
setAPIDes: Applies master, readout, or shutter trigger operation.
setAPICode:
setTriggerMode();
// Use disableTriggerMode() to select Master mode.

tooltip: Read Temperature – Reads the image sensor's internal temperature.
content1: Reads the temperature reported by the on-chip temperature sensor and displays the result in degrees Celsius.
content2: The returned temperature is displayed in the Temperature (°C) field.
struct1: Temperature is returned by the camera and displayed as degrees Celsius.
getAPIDes: Requests the current internal sensor temperature.
setAPIDes: Temperature is a read-only camera value.

tooltip: Enhancement Modes – Selects Auto, Low Light, or LED image enhancement.
content1: Selects image processing optimized for automatic operation, low-light visibility, or viewing LEDs with reduced blooming.
content2:
1. AUTO – Automatic enhancement mode.
2. LOW_LIGHT – Enhances visibility in low-light scenes.
3. LED – Improves LED visibility and reduces blooming.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current camera enhancement mode.
setAPIDes: Applies the selected enhancement mode.

tooltip: AE Hold – Runs auto exposure or retains the current exposure settings.
content1: Auto mode continuously calculates exposure. Hold mode retains the current exposure-control settings.
content2:
1. Auto – Disables hold and runs auto exposure.
2. Hold – Retains the current exposure settings.
getAPIDes: Retrieves whether auto exposure is running or held.
setAPIDes: Switches between automatic exposure and exposure hold.

tooltip: AE Convergence Speed – Adjusts how quickly auto exposure converges on the optimum range.
content1: Controls the rate at which auto exposure responds to lighting changes. Increasing the value increases convergence speed.
content2: The convergence-speed value is an integer supplied by the control range reported for the camera.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current AE convergence-speed value.
setAPIDes: Sets the AE convergence-speed value.

tooltip: Anti-Flicker Mode – Detects and mitigates illumination flicker.
content1: Configures flicker mitigation for automatic detection, 50 Hz lighting, 60 Hz lighting, or disabled operation.
content2:
1. Auto – Automatically detects and mitigates flicker.
2. 50 Hz – Mitigates detected 50 Hz flicker.
3. 60 Hz – Mitigates detected 60 Hz flicker.
4. Disable – Disables flicker mitigation.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current flicker-mitigation mode.
setAPIDes: Applies the selected flicker-mitigation mode.

tooltip: AE Window Overlay – Shows or hides the AE light-metering window on the image.
content1: Displays the AE light-metering window so its position can be checked. The overlay is present in preview and still capture, so disable it after configuration when it is no longer needed.
content2:
1. Disable – Hides the AE window overlay.
2. Enable – Displays the AE window overlay.
getAPIDes: Retrieves whether the AE window overlay is enabled.
setAPIDes: Shows or hides the AE window overlay.

tooltip: AE Window Dimensions – Sets the size and position of the AE light-metering window.
content1: Configures the width, height, and horizontal and vertical starting coordinates of the area used to calculate the AE evaluation value.
content2:
1. Width – Window width.
2. Height – Window height.
3. X Start – Horizontal starting position.
4. Y Start – Vertical starting position.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current AE window dimensions.
setAPIDes: Sets the size and position of the AE window.

tooltip: AE Mask Overlay – Shows or hides AE masking regions on the image.
content1: Displays AE masking regions so their positions can be checked. The overlay affects preview and still capture and should normally be disabled after configuration.
content2:
1. Disable – Hides the AE mask overlay.
2. Enable – Displays the AE mask overlay.
getAPIDes: Retrieves whether the AE mask overlay is enabled.
setAPIDes: Shows or hides AE masking regions.

tooltip: AE Mask – Configures up to five regions excluded from auto-exposure evaluation.
content1: Selects one of five AE masks, enables or disables it, and configures the mask size and position. Any combination of the five masks may be active concurrently.
content2:
1. Mask ID – Value from 1 through 5.
2. Mask State – Enable or disable.
3. Width and Height – Mask size.
4. X Start and Y Start – Mask position.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the state and dimensions of the selected AE mask.
setAPIHeading: setAEMaskDimensions(maskId, status, width, height, xStart, yStart)
setAPIDes: Sets the state, size, and position of the selected AE mask.
setAPICode: see3camcu31.setAEMaskDimensions(maskId, status, width, height, xStart, yStart);

tooltip: AWB Hold – Runs automatic white balance or retains the current white-balance settings.
content1: Auto mode continuously calculates white balance. Hold mode retains the current white-balance control settings.
content2:
1. Auto – Runs automatic white balance.
2. Hold – Retains the current white-balance settings.
getAPIDes: Retrieves whether automatic white balance is running or held.
setAPIDes: Switches between automatic white balance and white-balance hold.

tooltip: AWB Window Overlay – Shows or hides the AWB light-metering window.
content1: Displays the AWB light-metering window so its position can be checked. Disable the overlay after configuration when it is no longer needed.
content2:
1. Disable – Hides the AWB window overlay.
2. Enable – Displays the AWB window overlay.
getAPIDes: Retrieves whether the AWB window overlay is enabled.
setAPIDes: Shows or hides the AWB window overlay.

tooltip: AWB Window Dimensions – Sets the size and position of the AWB light-metering window.
content1: Configures the width, height, and starting coordinates of the area used to calculate the automatic white-balance value.
content2:
1. Width – Window width.
2. Height – Window height.
3. X Start – Horizontal starting position.
4. Y Start – Vertical starting position.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the current AWB window dimensions.
setAPIDes: Sets the size and position of the AWB window.

tooltip: AWB Mask Overlay – Shows or hides AWB masking regions on the image.
content1: Displays AWB masking regions so their positions can be checked. The overlay should normally be disabled after configuration.
content2:
1. Disable – Hides the AWB mask overlay.
2. Enable – Displays the AWB mask overlay.
getAPIDes: Retrieves whether the AWB mask overlay is enabled.
setAPIDes: Shows or hides AWB masking regions.

tooltip: AWB Mask – Configures up to five regions excluded from white-balance calculation.
content1: Selects one of five AWB masks, enables or disables it, and configures its size and position. Any combination of the five masks may be active concurrently.
content2:
1. Mask ID – Value from 1 through 5.
2. Mask State – Enable or disable.
3. Width and Height – Mask size.
4. X Start and Y Start – Mask position.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the state and dimensions of the selected AWB mask.
setAPIHeading: setAWBMaskDimensions(maskId, status, width, height, xStart, yStart)
setAPIDes: Sets the state, size, and position of the selected AWB mask.
setAPICode: see3camcu31.setAWBMaskDimensions(maskId, status, width, height, xStart, yStart);

tooltip: User Preset – Selects, saves, and chooses the default camera-control preset.
content1: Provides two persistent user presets and a manual mode. Settings can be stored in the selected user preset and a preset can be designated as the startup default.
content2:
1. User Preset 1 or 2 – Activates stored user settings.
2. Manual – Applies the current settings without selecting a stored preset.
3. Save Preset – Writes the current settings to the selected preset.
4. Set as Default – Selects the startup preset.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the currently selected user-preset mode.
setAPIDes: Selects, saves, or designates a preset as the startup default.

tooltip: Default – Restores the extension controls to their default values.
content1: Restores the camera extension controls to their factory default values.
content2: Apply the default command, then refresh the displayed camera-control values.
getAPIDes: This command does not retrieve a value.
setAPIDes: Restores extension controls to their defaults.

tooltip: Firmware Version – Reads the camera firmware version.
content1: Requests and displays the firmware version installed on the camera.
content2: A camera firmware-version string.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the camera firmware-version string.
setAPIDes: The firmware version is read-only.

tooltip: Serial Number – Reads the camera serial number.
content1: Requests and displays the unique serial number assigned to the camera.
content2: A camera serial-number value.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the camera serial number.
setAPIDes: The serial number is read-only.

tooltip: ISP Version – Reads the ISP firmware version.
content1: Requests and displays the firmware version of the camera's image signal processor.
content2: An ISP firmware-version string.
getAPIDes: Retrieves the ISP firmware-version string.
setAPIDes: The ISP firmware version is read-only.
